The '''Chief of Naval Operations''', also known as the '''Head of the Navy''' or the '''Chief of the Navy''', was the formal title for the head of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Navy]] and the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Naval Command (Imperial)|Command]]. In [[43 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] held the position. After the [[Attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu|assassination attempt]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sallinor Parova]] took over as acting Chief of Naval Operations.
